Route (c), the owner's decided route quoted in section 1, folds the effect into MantineListingCardPattern.module.css, whose D34 disposition is unlayered (section 6). The layer change is inherent to the chosen route and is what makes this file's guard the only guard.
Section 10.3 step 1 prescribes the replacement selector and its equal-specificity/source-order relation to half A. The specificity change is a consequence of that prescribed selector.
Section 10.3 step 1 requires the new rule to come second inside the same media block so that source order decides between it and the untouched half A.

Section 1 quotes the owner's instruction that the individual computed transform and scale values are expected to change, and section 9 states the required after form: one property carrying the whole 1.1025 product.

The --tw-scale-* bookkeeping properties exist only inside the removed utility and are consumed within that same rule. Deleting the utility, which route (c) requires, necessarily removes them; no other rule reads them.

Route (c) narrows the trigger from "any hovered .group ancestor" to ".cardGrid only". Revision 1 makes that narrowing safe rather than lossy: the owner decision quoted in its section 1 restructures the one consumer that relied on an outer .group (FavoritesShell) so the action now renders inside the Card, and the measured effectiveScale on the action is 1.1025, equal to the image and title hovers.
